items.control_name: Enforce Backup and DR Service Immutable Vaults against Ransomware
items.description: Production databases and stateful workloads must be backed up to an immutable Backup and DR Service vault with WORM retention.
items.current_value: Backup Vault 'vault-prod-immutable' active with 30-day WORM lock
items.recommended_value: Immutable backup vault enforced across all stateful production projects
items.remediation_notes: Test restoration of encrypted backups semi-annually.

items.control_name: Configure Automated Forensic Disk Snapshot Pipeline
items.description: Incident response workflows must be capable of automatically creating isolated, read-only forensic snapshots of VM disks upon SCC alert trigger.
items.current_value: Cloud Function 'secops-forensic-snapshot-bot' linked to SCC Critical alerts
items.recommended_value: Automated forensic snapshot capture active in 100% of projects
items.remediation_notes: Ensure forensic snapshots are stored in dedicated IR storage project.

items.control_name: Enforce Daily Resource Policy Snapshot Schedules on Compute Disks
items.description: All production VM boot and data disks must be attached to a Resource Policy snapshot schedule retaining backups for >= 14 days.
items.current_value: Snapshot schedule 'sched-daily-prod' attached to 14 of 16 VMs
items.recommended_value: 100% disk coverage with automated snapshot schedules
items.remediation_notes: Attach 'sched-daily-prod' to unmanaged disks on 'vm-app-03' and 'vm-app-04'.

items.control_name: Enforce Cross-Region Replication on Primary Cloud Storage Buckets
items.description: Business-critical Cloud Storage buckets must use Dual-Region or Multi-Region locations with Turbo Replication enabled.
items.current_value: Bucket 'gs://gs-prod-customer-data' configured as Dual-Region (us-east1, us-central1) with Turbo Replication
items.recommended_value: Dual-Region + Turbo Replication on all critical data stores
items.remediation_notes: Verify RPO < 15 minutes SLA under simulated region failover.
